identity.description: A high-contrast, dark-mode-first platform that feels like a law enforcement tool rather than a consumer app. It emphasizes data clarity, rapid identification, and security.

heading.usage: Use for all H1-H3 headings. Tracking tight (-0.02em). Uppercase for H6 labels.

body.usage: Primary UI text. optimized for legibility at small sizes.

mono.usage: Use for TPS Scores, Serial Numbers, IP addresses, and tabular data.

grid_system.marketing: Grid-cols-12 with gap-8. Asymmetrical bento grid for features.
grid_system.law_enforcement: Full-width fluid containers. Map taking 100% height where applicable.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.5)] rounded-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide

cards.default: bg-card/50 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 rounded-lg shadow-xl
cards.tps_score: relative overflow-hidden rounded-full border-4 flex items-center justify-center font-mono font-bold

inputs.default: bg-background border-input focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary rounded-md

visual_enhancers.scan_line: absolute w-full h-[2px] bg-primary/50 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(59,130,246,0.8)] animate-scan-vertical

hero_background.description: Dark cyber command center with multiple screens. Use as background for Hero section with heavy overlay.

law_enforcement_context.description: Police officer at night. Use for 'For Law Enforcement' section.

register_items.description: High value electronics (MacBook, iPhone, Camera). Use for 'Protect Your Valuables' section.

motion.loading: Use a radar-sweep animation or a digital decoding text effect.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is always #F8FAFC on dark backgrounds. Avoid dark grey on black.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: You are building a high-trust, authoritative security platform. Do not make it look like a playful startup. It should feel like 'The Batcomputer' or a SOC (Security Operations Center).
instructions_to_main_agent.theme_setup: Force Dark Mode by default. Do not implement a light mode unless absolutely necessary for accessibility toggles. Set 'class' mode in tailwind but default to dark variables.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard_layout: Use a fixed sidebar (left) and a top header. The main content area should be scrollable. Use 'Card' components for every widget.
instructions_to_main_agent.tps_logic: When displaying Theft Probability Score (TPS), use color coding: 0-30 (Green/Safe), 31-70 (Amber/Suspicious), 71-100 (Red/Stolen).
instructions_to_main_agent.maps: If implementing maps, use a dark-themed map style (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter) to match the UI.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts. Style the lines/bars with thin strokes and neon colors.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this. Make it distinctive.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for overlays and floating panels.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖 for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus states).
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
